```{r}
z <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/Data_files_export/bodydata.txt",header=TRUE)
tmp <- rep(0,nrow(z))
tmp[z$Gender == "M"] <- 1
z$Gender <- tmp
lm.model <- lm(Gender ~ ., data=z)
resid(lm.model)
fitted <- predict(lm.model,data=z)
predicted <- ifelse(fitted > 0.5,"M","F")
table(predicted,z$Gender)
```
